name: The Laws Of The Land
overview: Scripture teaches that earthly laws, such as those governing restitution for theft (Exodus 22:1) and paying tribute to governing authorities (Matthew 22:17), are to be respected but ultimately subordinate to God's commands. Believers are called to obey God rather than men when the two are in conflict (Acts 5:29), recognizing that God's commandments bring blessing and exaltation (Deuteronomy 28:1). The Holy Spirit guides believers in understanding and remembering God's teachings (John 14:26), while the call to righteous judgment cautions against hypocrisy (Romans 2:1). This balance underscores the primacy of divine law over human regulations in the believer's life.
